identity.title: Add batch import and projection command

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add an operator command that scans a caller-provided directory of Ailuros evidence packages, imports each idempotently, rebuilds projections/signals for successful imports, and prints a coverage/failure summary. It must not know where EverRun history lives. Dependency: 8025.build-overview-problems-console.
human_pressure.why_now: Dogfooding historical EverRun runs requires a repeatable bulk path without teaching Ailuros native EverRun directory structure.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Implement generic batch package import + projection over a directory of evidence packages.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8025.build-overview-problems-console. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
contracts: Input child is considered a package only through generic contract markers.
failure_semantics: Batch may complete partial_with_report style summary but must identify each failed package explicitly.

steps.title: Discover packages generically
details: Immediate child directories containing manifest/timeline contract.
Do not recurse into arbitrary runtime-native history.

steps.title: Import idempotently
details: Continue to next package on per-package validation failure while recording failure.

steps.title: Rebuild successful projections/signals
details: Separate import failure from projection failure in summary.

steps.title: Print deterministic batch summary
details: total/created/already_present/invalid/conflict/projected/projection_failed and mapping coverage aggregation when available.

acceptance: Batch input is a directory of Ailuros packages, not .everrun history.
Repeat batch run does not duplicate evidence/signals.
Per-package failures are reported without hiding successful packages.
Summary distinguishes import and projection failures.
validate: python -m ruff check src/ailuros/backfill.py src/ailuros/cli.py tests/test_batch_evidence_import.py

reject_if: One bad package aborts all already-safe independent packages without reporting partial results.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
